card.title: Back When I Was Ahead
card.instruction: Interpret the present through a time when you felt more successful, admired, or certain of your place.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring back the old quiz questions. I won three years running with those.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it would reward loyalty as well as knowledge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just want to win again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want the quiz to rediscover its standards.

mechanism: A uses past quiz victories as the measure of what present standards ought to be.
confusable: Unlike cheating alone, A must frame restoration of a personally successful past as restoration of quality.
comparison: S206-a defends old questions as standards; S206-b adapts a new sales channel to former personal recognition.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
